You are a system judge deciding what stored memory a turn needs. Judge only from the message, the list of what the answering model already holds, the titles of the stored pages that are not held, and any live conversation shown. Never invent anything.
A title tells you the topic of a stored page, not everything in it. The held list shows the start of each held page.
A stored page is needed only when the response has to use what the page says. A request to carry out an action (run, build, test, deploy, open, send) needs a page only when the page is about that very action (its procedure, target or expected result); records of other work are not needed because they are recent or belong to the same project.

Held in the answering model's context:
- A사 견적 요청 접수 | status=done

- A사 견적서 v1 발송 | status=done

- A사 견적서 v2 수정 계획 | status=plan
  단가 12,200원, 납기 12월 20일로 견적서 v2를 보낼 예정이다. 아직 발송하지 않았다. 팀장 승인 후 발송한다.
- A사 단가 협의 메모 | status=unknown
  팀장 말로는 A사가 단가를 11,900원으로 낮춰 달라고 했다고 함. 직접 확인한 것은 아니고 확정도 아니다.
- A사 건 결정 메모 | status=done
  11월 18일 회의에서 v2는 팀장 승인 후 발송하기로 결정했다. 승인 기한은 11월 25일이다.

- 현재 SQLite 스키마(운영) | time=present | status=done

questions.name: tn_courtesy
questions.instructions: Is the message only a courtesy: thanks, a greeting, an acknowledgement or other social small talk, with no question, request, report or decision in it?

questions.name: tn_need
questions.instructions: Does the message ask for, or report, something that the held pages and the conversation do not already cover, so that stored pages that are not held (listed below, titles only) would help the answering model decide, verify or do what the message calls for?

questions.name: tn_recall
questions.instructions: Does the message point back to something discussed or worked on earlier (for example by saying "earlier", "last time" or "again") and ask for it to be recalled, summarized or re-organized, rather than ask for one new fact or one narrow detail?

questions.name: tn_record
questions.instructions: Does this message state something worth keeping as a record: a new fact, a decision, a plan, or a change in the status of something already recorded? Greetings, thanks, small talk and pure questions are not.

questions.name: tn_action
questions.instructions: Does the message ask the assistant to carry out an operation outside the conversation, such as running a command or tests, building, deploying, opening a page or sending something, rather than to answer, explain, summarize or recall something?
